phases.name: single-repo manual pipeline
phases.description: Using Syft, Grype, and cosign CLIs directly (no automation yet), walk ONE real repo through: generate SBOM -> scan for CVEs -> sign the release artifact with cosign using keyless OIDC signing -> attach the SBOM as a signed attestation. Document in RUNBOOK.md. Verify with cosign verify-attestation.
phases.summary: Phase 1 was successfully completed by running the manual supply chain security pipeline for the billflow repository. Using Syft, a CycloneDX JSON SBOM (sbom.json) was generated, which was then scanned for CVEs using Grype. Keyless OIDC signing via cosign was performed to sign the release artifact (billflow-release.zip) and attach the SBOM as a signed attestation. Both the artifact signature and SBOM attestation were successfully verified against the OIDC identity (tatibaraka@gmail.com / accounts.google.com), and the pipeline walkthrough was fully documented in RUNBOOK.md.

phases.name: reusable workflow + rollout
phases.description: Convert Phase 1 runbook into a reusable GitHub Actions workflow file (.github/workflows/supply-chain.yml) triggered on release tag push. Integrate slsa-github-generator. Add to 3-4 real repos.
phases.summary: Phase 2 has been successfully completed. The manual supply chain security pipeline from Phase 1 was successfully converted into an automated GitHub Actions workflow file (`supply-chain.yml`) and rolled out to all four target repositories configured in `fleet.config.json` (`billflow`, `bookflow`, `privaforge`, and `solocrm`). The workflow is triggered automatically upon tag pushes matching the `v*` pattern, running checkout, installing pinned versions of Syft, Grype, and Cosign via commit SHAs, generating a CycloneDX SBOM, performing a vulnerability scan, creating a release zip archive, signing it keylessly, attaching the SBOM as a signed attestation, and finally generating and uploading SLSA Build Level 2 provenance using the pinned `slsa-github-generator` generic generator workflow.

phases.name: fleet aggregator
phases.description: Build TypeScript CLI chainproof report --config fleet.config.json. Pull/verify SBOM attestation and provenance, parse Grype scan results, output combined report.
